current.zh-CN: 当前步骤的索引，对应 v-model:current；不传时由组件自己保存，从 0 开始。
current.en-US: Index of the current step, for v-model:current. Without it the component keeps the index itself, starting at 0.

finishText.zh-CN: 最后一步完成按钮的文本；为空时使用语言包中的文案。
finishText.en-US: Text of the finish button on the last step. When empty, the text from the locale pack is used.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: modal 模式下弹窗渲染至该 DOM 中；popup 模式下指向 body 以外的元素时不锁定 body 滚动。气泡卡片位于 top layer，不受此属性影响。
getPopupContainer.en-US: In modal mode the dialog is rendered into this DOM node. In popup mode body scrolling is not locked when it points to an element other than body. The popover card sits in the top layer and is not affected.

mask.zh-CN: 是否显示蒙层，可被步骤的 mask 覆盖。
mask.en-US: Whether to show the mask. A step's own mask overrides it.

mode.zh-CN: 引导模式：popup 为气泡卡片，modal 为弹窗。
mode.en-US: Guide mode: popup for a bubble card, modal for a dialog.

nextButtonProps.zh-CN: 下一步按钮的属性，可含 class、style 与 onClick；onClick 先于内置处理调用，按钮文本使用 nextText 插槽。
nextButtonProps.en-US: Props of the next button, which may include class, style and onClick. onClick is called before the built-in handling; use the nextText slot for the button text.

position.zh-CN: 气泡卡片相对于目标元素的位置，可被步骤的 position 覆盖。
position.en-US: Position of the bubble card relative to the target element. A step's own position overrides it.

prevButtonProps.zh-CN: 上一步按钮的属性，可含 class、style 与 onClick；onClick 先于内置处理调用，按钮文本使用 prevText 插槽。
prevButtonProps.en-US: Props of the previous button, which may include class, style and onClick. onClick is called before the built-in handling; use the prevText slot for the button text.

showPrevButton.zh-CN: 是否显示上一步按钮，第一步不显示。
showPrevButton.en-US: Whether to show the previous button. It is never shown on the first step.

showSkipButton.zh-CN: 是否显示跳过按钮，最后一步不显示。
showSkipButton.en-US: Whether to show the skip button. It is never shown on the last step.

spotlightPadding.zh-CN: 高亮区域的外扩距离，单位为像素，可被步骤的 spotlightPadding 覆盖；都未设置时为 5。
spotlightPadding.en-US: Extra space in pixels around the highlighted area. A step's own spotlightPadding overrides it; 5 when neither is set.

steps.zh-CN: 引导步骤的数据；标题、描述和封面的自定义内容使用 title、description、cover 插槽。
steps.en-US: Data of the guide steps. Use the title, description and cover slots for custom content.

theme.zh-CN: popup 模式的主题，可被步骤的 theme 覆盖。
theme.en-US: Theme of the popup mode. A step's own theme overrides it.

visible.zh-CN: 是否显示引导，对应 v-model:visible。
visible.en-US: Whether the guide is shown, for v-model:visible.

zIndex.zh-CN: popup 模式下遮罩的层级，modal 模式下弹窗的层级。气泡卡片位于 top layer，始终在遮罩之上。
zIndex.en-US: The z-index of the mask in popup mode and of the dialog in modal mode. The popover card sits in the top layer, always above the mask.

update:current.zh-CN: 步骤改变时触发，值为新的索引，供 v-model:current 回写；先于 change。
update:current.en-US: Emitted with the new index when the step changes, for v-model:current to write back. It comes before change.

update:visible.zh-CN: 点击跳过、按 Esc 或完成引导时触发，值为 false，供 v-model:visible 回写；先于 skip 与 finish。
update:visible.en-US: Emitted with false when the guide is skipped, Escape is pressed or the guide is finished, for v-model:visible to write back. It comes before skip and finish.

change.zh-CN: 步骤改变时触发，参数为新的索引。
change.en-US: Emitted with the new index when the step changes.

next.zh-CN: 点击下一步按钮时触发，参数为新的索引；最后一步触发 finish。
next.en-US: Emitted with the new index when the next button is clicked. The last step emits finish instead.

prev.zh-CN: 点击上一步按钮时触发，参数为新的索引。
prev.en-US: Emitted with the new index when the previous button is clicked.

skip.zh-CN: 点击跳过按钮或按 Esc 时触发。
skip.en-US: Emitted when the skip button is clicked or Escape is pressed.

finish.zh-CN: 点击最后一步的完成按钮时触发。
finish.en-US: Emitted when the finish button on the last step is clicked.

title.zh-CN: 步骤标题，作用域参数为 `{ item, index }`；渲染为空时使用 item.title。
title.en-US: Step title, with scope `{ item, index }`. When it renders nothing, item.title is used.

description.zh-CN: 步骤描述，作用域参数为 `{ item, index }`；渲染为空时使用 item.description。
description.en-US: Step description, with scope `{ item, index }`. When it renders nothing, item.description is used.

cover.zh-CN: 步骤封面，作用域参数为 `{ item, index }`；不提供时该步骤没有封面区。
cover.en-US: Step cover, with scope `{ item, index }`. Without it the step has no cover area.

nextText.zh-CN: 下一步按钮的文本，最后一步显示 finishText；不提供时使用语言包中的文案。
nextText.en-US: Text of the next button; the last step shows finishText. Without it the text from the locale pack is used.

prevText.zh-CN: 上一步按钮的文本；不提供时使用语言包中的文案。
prevText.en-US: Text of the previous button. Without it the text from the locale pack is used.
